THE CHASE IS ON.... 

A GRITTY STORY OF INNOCENCE LOST AND DARKNESS GAINED...

THE CHASE IS ON.

Detective Iris Williams is the NYPD's top detective. A cop with more arrests and convictions than anyone else in the department. She's built her reputation on instinct, discipline, and street knowledge.
Nothing rattles her.
Nothing gets to her.
Until now.
Assigned to a case that feels wrong from the moment she steps onto the crime scene, Detective Iris Williams finds herself hunting a pair of killers like on other- a pair of sixteen-year-old, identical twin sisters. Beneath the twins' calm exterior lies something cold, calculating, and dark. They are like ghosts in a city that never sleeps- elusive, brilliant, and hell-bent on vengeance. Every crime scene is a message that will bring Detective Iris Williams closer to the shocking truth about the twins.
As the city spirals and the twins' madness unfolds, Detective Iris Williams knows that she'll have to take extra steps- and have the right partner- in order to apprehend two of the most dangerous, elusive, and youngest serial killers she's ever encountered, THE TWINS.

WARNING: R.G MILLER'S IRIS WILLIAMS AND ANNETTE TONI NOVELS DEPICT GRAPHIC CRIME SCENES.
